title: Steampunk Upholstery Workshop
description: You are a steampunk artisan customizing a luxurious chair using a gear-driven material mixing machine. Rotate the gears to blend material properties like metallic, roughness, emissive intensity, color hue, and normal map strength, then apply each mixed material to different parts of the chair. Achieve the target material recipe displayed on screen to complete the workshop challenge.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Steampunk Upholstery Workshop. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: 'shared_assets/gears.glb' (a set of interlocking gears) and 'shared_assets/ChairDamaskPurplegold.glb' (an ornate damask chair). Position the gear mechanism on the left side of the scene and the chair on the right. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at the center, with OrbitControls for navigation. Add an AmbientLight (intensity 0.4), a DirectionalLight from upper-right (intensity 1.0), and a warm PointLight near the gears (orange tint, intensity 0.6). The gears serve as a material mixing machine. Create an HTML overlay panel with 5 sliders labeled: Metallic (0-1), Roughness (0-1), Emissive Intensity (0-2), Hue Shift (0-360), and Normal Scale (0-3). When any slider changes, animate the gears rotating proportionally to the slider delta. Apply a MeshStandardMaterial to the chair that updates in real-time: metalness and roughness from sliders, emissiveIntensity from slider with emissive color derived from hue shift, and color computed by rotating the base purple-gold hue by the Hue Shift value using HSL conversion. Add a 'Apply Material' button that locks the current settings onto the chair with a flash animation (brief emissive spike). Display a target recipe panel showing 5 random target values. Track how many parameters the user has matched within ±0.05 tolerance (±10 for hue). Show a match counter (e.g., '3/5 matched'). After all 5 match and the user clicks Apply, trigger a celebration: gears spin rapidly, chair emits golden particles using a simple point sprite particle system, and display 'Workshop Complete!' text. Require at least 6 distinct interactions: adjusting 5 sliders and clicking apply. Validate each parameter against the target before allowing completion. Include subtle gear ambient rotation in the animation loop. Ensure the scene has a dark industrial background color (0x1a1a2e).
